data.title: Mobile working addendum to employment contract
data.summary: Beispiel Logistik GmbH sent an addendum to your employment contract allowing mobile working up to two days per week from 1 June 2026. You must return it signed within 10 working days of the letter date (28 April 2026).
data.explanation: Your employer sent an addendum (Zusatzvereinbarung) to your employment contract about mobile working, up to two days a week, starting 1 June 2026. If you agree, sign it and send it back to the HR department (Personalabteilung) by the deadline shown, which counts 10 working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the letter date. Check the terms before signing. If you have doubts, you may want advice.
